facts.text: Graduates of participating high schools receive a locked-in tuition rate of $12,000 per year ($6,000 per semester) for on-campus programs.

sources.title: New England College Offers $12000 Annual Tuition, Locked in for ...
sources.quote: Eligible graduates of participating high schools must enroll full-time in an eligible on-campus undergraduate program. Tuition is $12,000 per year ($6,000 per semester), plus required fees.
